gen.orderNote: Follows real flight order from takeoff to landing

steps.label: single ground speed
steps.quote: An aircraft’s flight is not conducted at a single ground speed

steps.label: zero at takeoff
steps.quote: varies from zero at takeoff, to cruise conditions, and back to zero at landing.

steps.label: Extra fuel
steps.quote: Extra fuel is expended in climbing to altitude and in maneuvering the aircraft.

steps.label: weight constantly changes
steps.quote: The weight constantly changes as fuel is burned.

steps.label: fuel consumption rate
steps.quote: So, the lift, drag, thrust, and fuel consumption rate also continually change.

steps.label: fuel reserve
steps.quote: there is usually a fuel reserve; and the pilot makes sure to land the plane with fuel still on board.
